Ayat is a Quran app with a highly customizable widget extension that shows a random verse of the Quran every hour.  The customization options include choosing the widget colors, font, and how the widget updates its aya, the update methods can be randomly or a still aya.
Ayat app includes the following features:
- The app allows you to add widgets to the home screen or the lock screen.
- The app allows you to add multiple widgets and customize each one individually.
- The app allows you to copy or share the verses to your favorite social media platform.
- The app has a widget extension that shows a random verse of the Quran. The widget gets added to your home screen and it updates automatically every hour by default.
- You have full control of how often the verse gets updated, the background color of the widget, the text color of the verse, and you can also show or hide the sora name and the verse number.
- The widget supports iOS 16 lock screen widgets.

This app uses Hafs Narration provided by King Fahad Glorious Quran Printing Complex.
